The '''Droid Uprising''' was an event in [[97 BBY]] which occurred after [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] was first settled by the [[Bakur Mining Corporation]]. The [[H'Lokk Consortium]] infected the droids with a virus that instructed them to sabotage the settlers' colonization efforts. The virus was flawed, however, and began to delete the non-violent programing in the droids. The droids infected went on a killing spree, in which the settlers lost 40% of their people. However, within a week the droids were disposed of, halting H'Lokk's plans. The revolt started [[Bakuran]] [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|distrust]] of them and lawful requirement of visiting droids to wear [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]].
